nodes.label: Next.js Decoupling Shim (design rationale for standalone export)
nodes.rationale: onboarding-shell.tsx is copied verbatim from the main Next.js app's src/app/onboarding/onboarding-shell.tsx. Two Next.js-only imports (useRouter from next/navigation, Link from next/link) are replaced with a small shim block (log+alert stand-in for navigation, plain <a> for Link) so the component can run standalone outside Next.js, while keeping every step component, all state, and inline styles identical to the original. Re-integration only requires deleting the shim, restoring 'use client' and the two original imports.
